name: Rice Machinery Machine Tools SALES, Service
old_description: Rice Machinery specializes in selling new machine tools, CNC controls, custom building, refurbishing and modernizing used machinery for all manufacturing industries including schools and colleges. We stand by our products 100%, and are well known to take great pride in our work and customer satisfaction.
about:
Rice Machinery is based in Cranston, Rhode Island. The company traces its roots to 1968 when S. Arnold Rice established the business, originally known as Reynolds of Baker Street. Current owner Cory McLaughlin continues the operation, serving customers throughout New England.

The company operates as an authorized distributor for Sharp CNC machine tools and Acu-Rite G2 CNC controls, while also selling new and used repair parts, buying and trading used machinery, and providing retrofitting services that add 2- or 3-axis CNC technology to existing knee or bed mills. Its facilities include a 4,000-square-foot showroom, a 15,000-square-foot main warehouse, and three additional warehouses across Rhode Island, supported by an in-house CNC demonstration, parts, and rebuilding department with three service trucks making daily calls.

Rice Machinery serves a broad range of manufacturing industries as well as educational institutions such as schools and colleges across the New England region. Customers include job shops, production facilities, and academic programs seeking new or refurbished machine tools, CNC upgrades, and on-site repair or training.

The firm emphasizes its long-standing reputation for quality products and service that exceeds expectations, built on a tradition started in 1968 and maintained through hands-on technical support, including in-house and on-site CNC control training.
